name: seis-agent-contract-validator
description: Read-only validation of supervised SEIS agent purpose, permissions, approvals, and handoff contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Audit agent boundaries before supervised execution.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local SEIS validator for JSON agent contracts. It checks identity, purpose, permission arrays, approval gates, forbidden actions, validation, audit, rollback, and handoff hints without running agents.
defaultPrompt: Check approvals and rollback hints safely.
